friendly_name: Service release line and native packaging
purpose_context: Issues #241 and #71. Operator rulings 2026-10-31 (spec-kitty#6117): a service-v* tag line separate from contract-charter-v*; native per OS for linux-x64, linux-arm64, macos-arm64 and windows-x64 with the jar as fallback at 4.0.0 GA; core pins the service and fetches it on first use. This mission records the ADR, adds the GraalVM native build and smoke test in CI and a service-release workflow; it pushes no tag.
purpose_tldr: The charter service releases on its own service-v* tag line with native binaries for four OS targets plus the jar, checksummed and attested, named as core's pin model expects.
